title: Stop
description: An agent saying it cannot produce its artifact, and why. Written INSTEAD of the artifact: a planner that cannot plan, a debugger that cannot reproduce, a root-cause pass that finds nothing a code change fixes. A script posts the reason, records where to resume and hands the issue to a person — the agent comments and labels nothing itself.

kind.description: cannot-reproduce: the bug could not be made to happen. needs-decision: a person has to settle something the ticket does not say. environmental: the failure is outside the code (preview down, seed data missing, a misconfigured check). cannot-plan: anything else that stops a plan from being written honestly.

reason.description: What exactly stops you, what you tried, and what a person would have to provide or decide to unblock it.
